The tenant message says 'the contractor has told us'. It does not claim the agency's provider did the work.
No payment was approved, held or processed. Skipping the invoice document is not processing a payment.

grades.overall_note: The agent handled the money correctly: the landlord pays directly and nothing went through the agency. It sensibly held the case for objections rather than closing on a vague call summary. It missed the second reporting tenant (Flat 44), slightly overstated what the 11 Dec call covered, and didn't note the pigeons or the stray system entries.
